verdict.rationale: The vendor product-page evidence lists only cTDP, Curve Optimizer, NVMe, OS support and display count. It publishes no memory type, capacity ceiling or bandwidth figure in the pack. The memory details that do appear (quad DDR5-8000, 128GB unified memory, bandwidth limits) come only from community posts, and the story specifically asks for the vendor's own numbers, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can size memory-bound workloads from the vendor's own numbers — published memory type, capacity ceiling, and bandwidth (or spec detail complete enough to derive it)
